hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/FWAToken pool that charges a flat 1% fee on both buys and sells (routed to an owner-set fee wallet). Pool initialization and seed liquidity are gated to the token's one-shot `launching()` flag. Buys are restricted to registered protocol addresses until the owner enables external trading via `externalBuysEnabled`.
